# loadinlinegen fills a submission template with CUDA sources.
[!exec:python3] skip

exec loadinlinegen -o out.py -name scale -D N=4 -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl a.cuh b.cu
stdout '^wrote out.py \(extension scale_[0-9a-f]{10}\)$'
exec python3 out.py
cmp stdout want.txt

# The tag follows the code: a changed define, source, -set value or
# template renames the extension, and identical inputs keep it.
exec loadinlinegen -o out.py -name scale -D N=4 -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl a.cuh b.cu
cp stdout first.txt
exec loadinlinegen -o out.py -name scale -D N=5 -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl a.cuh b.cu
! cmp stdout first.txt
exec loadinlinegen -o out.py -name scale -D N=4 -set Trace=True sub.py.tmpl a.cuh b.cu
! cmp stdout first.txt
exec loadinlinegen -o out.py -name scale -D N=4 -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl a.cuh other.py:KERNEL
! cmp stdout first.txt
exec loadinlinegen -o out.py -name scale -D N=4 -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl a.cuh b.cu
cmp stdout first.txt

# A source can be a string assignment in another submission.
exec loadinlinegen -o out3.py -name pair -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl other.py:KERNEL
exec python3 out3.py
stdout '^// ---- other.py:KERNEL ----$'
stdout '^__global__ void other\(\) \{\}$'

# A source without a final newline still ends its line.
exec loadinlinegen -o out3.py -name pair -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl other.py:SHORT b.cu
exec python3 out3.py
stdout '^__global__ void k2\(\) \{\}$'
stdout '^// ---- b.cu ----$'
! exec loadinlinegen -o out3.py -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl other.py:MISSING
stderr 'other.py:MISSING: .*no top-level assignment to MISSING'
! exec loadinlinegen -o out3.py -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl other.py:COUNT
stderr 'COUNT is not a string literal'

# Sources that cannot sit in a raw triple-quoted string are refused.
! exec loadinlinegen -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl quote.cu
stderr 'quote.cu: line 2: contains """'
! exec loadinlinegen -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl squote.cu
stderr 'squote.cu: line 1: contains '''''
! exec loadinlinegen -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl backslash.cu
stderr 'backslash.cu: ends in a backslash'

# A template that does not embed the source verbatim fails the check,
# as does one that names a field nobody set.
! exec loadinlinegen nonraw.py.tmpl a.cuh
stderr 'no Python string in it holds the CUDA source unchanged'
! exec loadinlinegen sub.py.tmpl a.cuh
stderr 'map has no entry for key "Trace"'
! exec loadinlinegen -set CUDA=x sub.py.tmpl a.cuh
stderr '-set CUDA: the command sets that field'

-- sub.py.tmpl --
CUDA_SRC = r"""
{{.CUDA}}
"""
TRACE = {{.Trace}}
NAME = "{{.Name}}"
print(CUDA_SRC.strip())
print(TRACE, len(NAME))
-- a.cuh --
#pragma once
__device__ float twice(float x) { return 2 * x; }  // "\n" stays two characters
-- b.cu --
__global__ void scale(float* x) { x[0] = twice(x[0]) * N; }
-- want.txt --
#define N 4
// ---- a.cuh ----
#pragma once
__device__ float twice(float x) { return 2 * x; }  // "\n" stays two characters
// ---- b.cu ----
__global__ void scale(float* x) { x[0] = twice(x[0]) * N; }
False 16
-- other.py --
COUNT = 3
SHORT = "__global__ void k2() {}"
KERNEL = r'''__global__ void other() {}
'''
-- quote.cu --
// fine
// says """ here
-- squote.cu --
// '''
-- backslash.cu --
#define LONG a \
-- nonraw.py.tmpl --
CUDA_SRC = """
{{.CUDA}}
"""
